title: Ants and their nests
examples: What is the job of the queen ant?
How do ants build their homes?

explain.say: Say, ants live together in big groups called colonies.
Say, the queen ant is the special mother of the colony.
say, worker ants are the helpers who do all the work.
say, ants build many tunnels under the ground to live in.
say, a real ant colony uses tunnels to keep safe from rain.

draw.text: Tunnels keep ants safe from rain.

explain.say: say, sometimes students think all ants do the same job always.

draw.text: Mistake: All ants do the same job.

faq.q: Does the queen ant ever leave the nest?
faq.a: Generally, the queen stays deep inside the nest to lay eggs. She needs to stay safe to do her important job.
asks: Does the queen need to be near the eggs?

faq.q: What do worker ants eat for the colony?
faq.a: Worker ants are very busy finding food like seeds or sweet things. They bring this food back to the nest for everyone.
asks: What is the worker ant's job with food?

faq.q: Are the tunnels always straight lines?
faq.a: No, the tunnels are often winding and curved paths. This helps the ants get to different areas of the nest.
asks: How do ants move through their tunnels?

faq.q: Do all ants look exactly the same?
faq.a: No, there are different types of ants, and they have different jobs. The queen and workers look different.
They build tunnels for safety and to keep their eggs and food dry. It keeps them safe from predators.
asks: What is the purpose of tunnels?

facts: The queen ant's main job is to lay eggs for the colony.
Worker ants are responsible for finding food and building tunnels.
Ant tunnels help keep the colony safe from weather.
A colony is a group of many ants living together.

quiz.say: Which ant is mainly responsible for laying eggs?
quiz.why: The queen ant is the mother ant and her job is to lay eggs for the colony.

wrong.0: Not all ants do the same job; the queen has a special role.
wrong.2: Worker ants are the helpers; they do the work, but they do not lay the eggs.
wrong.3: Soldier ants protect the nest, but only the queen lays the eggs.

quiz.say: If an ant colony needs to hide from rain, where will they go?
quiz.why: Tunnels dug underground keep the ants safe and dry from rain above ground.

wrong.1: Leaves can get wet and are not safe from rain.
wrong.2: The open dirt does not protect them from the rain.
wrong.3: While rocks offer shade, tunnels are specifically built for safety.

quiz.say: If you see an ant carrying a large crumb, which ant is it most likely to be?
quiz.why: Worker ants are the helpers; they are always busy finding and carrying food for the colony.

wrong.0: The queen ant stays mostly inside and does not forage for food.
wrong.1: Soldier ants mainly guard the entrance, not carry food.
wrong.2: Baby ants are too small to carry big food items.
